deploy-bot: Starting PROD rollout to us-east-1 (change window 21:00-22:00 UTC). Deploying commits `c7a1b2d` (author: @sam) and `b4f2e00` (author: @mira). PR refs: <https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/repo/pull/430|PR #430>, <https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/repo/pull/429|PR #429>. Release notes: "hotfix: reduce tokenization latency for small requests". Canary: 2 nodes, ETA ~8m.

sam: This includes the rate-limit hotfix we merged earlier. cc @alexa for SDK bump.

alexa: Please pin runtime to `redwood-runtime:2.4.1` for this rollout, last autoswitch caused perf variance.

jen: change window is fine from my side. If we must rollback, prefer runtime pin rollback vs full revert.

deploy-bot: Runtime pinned to `redwood-runtime:2.4.1` per @alexa.

deploy-bot: Canary health: ✅ 2/2 nodes healthy. p50 68ms, p95 205ms. No 5xx in last 5m.

owen: quick log pass — no 5xx, a few transient 429s during burst but below alerting threshold.

sam: good, proceed to full region.

deploy-bot: Promoting to full prod-us-east-1. Deploy metadata: commit_shas: `c7a1b2d`,`b4f2e00`; authors: Sam (<https://git.redwood.com/u/sam>), Mira (<https://git.redwood.com/u/mira>); release_tag: `v2026.03.19-rl-hotfix`; change_window: 21:00-22:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: Monitoring window started. Alerts set: error-rate >0.5% or p95 >300ms for 2 consecutive mins.

deploy-bot: Full rollout complete at 1920501499. No rollback. If you see regressions, ping #incidents and mention @oncall.

mira: small wording tweak in release doc.

alexa: running client integration tests now.

jen: adding notes for post-deploy baseline + perf/cost comparison.

sam: ack, thanks all.
